thread:
ana: thinking about a 'fallback surgeon' UX: let SREs selectively roll back fallback for specific user cohorts or single request ids, not just whole routes. want quick ops + eng feedback.
chris: interesting. operator inbox needs a way to surface affected cohort + a quick sandbox to test a single request. maybe an inline "replay" button per sample.
leah: agree on replay. UI should show request_id, trigger_reason, and a small "re-run under primary" preview. show redaction shield if sample was scrubbed.
kevin: backend note: add fields to telemetry: trigger_id, request_ids_sampled, cohort_selector (e.g., header: {X-Redwood-Test: beta}), and a surgeon_action event when an operator un-degrades a cohort.
ops-bot: Alert: fallback applied to /assist at 2024-10-03T02:14:05Z (trigger_id=trg_sg1).
nana: typo: ana meant. ops question: if we un-degrade a single request and it fails, should we auto-reapply fallback? risk of loops.
chris: add a per-request retry limit with hysteresis. surgeon action should create a short-lived override: {type: manual_unfreeze, expires_s:600, max_retries:1}.
leah: audit: every surgeon action must be immutable with operator id, before/after policy snapshot, and the sample trace. link to blobstore.
kevin: implement surgeon_action telemetry events and a replay endpoint that runs sample through primary in safe-sim mode (no billing side effects). returns quality deltas.
nana: (again, ana) UI: show small scalpel icon on route row -> click -> open "Surgeon" panel with samples, cohort selector, preview button, and [Apply Manual Unfreeze] (role-gated).
ops-bot: Note: quota-related surgeon actions should include affected_commit_id for billing trace.
leah: privacy: default redaction of samples; unredact must be explicit and logged.
nana: next steps: kevin will spec telemetry + replay endpoint, leah will mock the Surgeon panel, chris will draft fail-safe hysteresis. reconvene tomorrow 11am. :thumbsup:
